## Goal

Publish docket to crates.io so users can `cargo install docket`.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Verify Cargo.toml has required metadata (description, license, repository)
- [ ] Create crates.io account if needed
- [ ] Publish with `cargo publish`
- [ ] Document installation in README
- [ ] Consider pre-built binaries via GitHub releases

## Context

Easiest installation path for Rust users is cargo install. Need proper metadata first.
